460196.overview:
Take on the role of Zoe Ryen, Command Pilot in the top secret Elite Xeno Operations.

Your E.X.O. team have been betrayed and scattered across the galaxy, imprisoned by the Saruut, Earth's one-time ally. Operating from a hidden base, you are now their only hope for rescue and to uncover the dark secrets of the Saruut that threatens the very existence of humanity.

You have command of a Wasp Tactical extraction Covert Mark 5 spaceship. Flying frem the secret Artemis E.X.O. base, you will need to use every ounce of flying skill and experience (as well as your blaster and rockets!) to infiltrate, shooot, battle and puzzle your way to victory, to rescue your team, and save Earth.

An intergalactic adventure spread over five worlds with over 110 screens full of enemies, traps, and puzzles, a full fifteen track musical score, five bosses to defeat, secrets to unlock and much more.
